scripts.build:plugin: npm run build -w @sdd/core-system && npm run build -w @sdd/fs-ts-system
scripts.typecheck:plugin: npm run typecheck -w @sdd/core-system && npm run typecheck -w @sdd/fs-ts-system
scripts.logs: bash -c 'LOG_DIR="sdd/system-logs"; if [ ! -d "$LOG_DIR" ]; then echo "No logs found. The sdd/system-logs/ directory does not exist yet."; echo "Run an sdd-system command to generate logs."; exit 0; fi; LATEST=$(ls -t "$LOG_DIR"/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then echo "No log files found in $LOG_DIR"; exit 0; fi; echo "Tailing: $LATEST"; tail -f "$LATEST" | npx pino-pretty'
